subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Setpoint and Error Signal
description: A quick win: understand Setpoint and Error Signal.

hook.text: Set your thermostat to 22°C. That target is the setpoint — the goal the system chases.

buildup.text: The error signal is the difference between setpoint and actual output: error = setpoint − measured.

discovery.text: The controller's only job is to drive the error toward zero as quickly and smoothly as possible.

twist.text: A step change in setpoint creates a sudden large error — the controller must respond without overshooting.

climax.text: Cruise control, industrial ovens, and water treatment all continuously chase their setpoints.

punchline.text: Know the goal, measure the gap, close it — every controller chases its setpoint.
